summary.what_it_does: The page is Evernote's marketing page, and it does not describe Skitch's features directly. The only Skitch-specific claim in the provided listing is that it is a screen capture application with powerful annotation capabilities, listed under Screenshot Tools on awesome-mac. The page text describes Evernote as a note-taking app for capturing ideas, organizing notes, managing tasks and schedules, and syncing across devices. It also mentions AI features in Evernote v11, real-time collaboration, and saving content by recording, transcribing, scanning, or clipping.
